placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
St Andrews Park is a place to spend an easy afternoon close to the city's residential streets. Its grassy areas and trees offer room for a picnic without organising a long countryside trip.

Our family idea: choose a comfortable patch of lawn, bring a favourite storybook and leave time for the play area. Keep seasonal extras as a bonus rather than promising them before you check.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families looking for a local picnic and playground combination.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Park lawns and a children's play area; consult current visitor information for other facilities.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Use public transport or legal local parking, respecting nearby homes.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: The park has sloping ground. Check the council page before relying on seasonal water play or refreshments.
